name: @patternlike/api

scripts.prebuild: npm run check:pattern-source && npm run check:validators
scripts.//build: Dry-runs the SAME environment `deploy` ships. Without --env production this validated the top-level dev block (AUTH_STUB=1, issuer.invalid, the placeholder D1 id) and so could never catch a production-only config error; it also tripped Workers Builds' Worker-name check, whose remedy is a PR renaming the top-level worker to patternlike-api-production. Requires apps/web/dist to exist — see the root //build note.
scripts.//typecheck: BOTH configs. Worker sources compile without Node types on purpose; scripts/ needs them. One command so a script cannot drift out of the gate.
scripts.//publisher:pattern:model:verify: PRODUCTION GATE, not part of any test lane. Uses OPENAI_API_KEY to prove every distinct compiled Pattern model exists and accepts the contract's pattern keyword in a minimal strict-schema response. Prints no provider prose. Required before initial enablement and after any Pattern model or strict-schema derivation change.
scripts.//ontology:release:verify: Offline second opinion on a downloaded active ontology bundle: recomputes the bundle hash from the canonical signing payload, verifies the signature against an explicitly supplied keyring, compiles the release, and requires machine_pipeline provenance. Every expectation is an explicit argument and the output is bounded to identity plus a closed pass/fail code -- release rules and reader-facing meanings never reach a terminal, a CI log, or a ticket.
scripts.//test: The serial and pre-0003 compatibility Worker suites, followed by operator-script and generated-validator checks. Script tests live outside both Vitest include patterns, so they must be chained here.
scripts.pretest: npm run check:pattern-source && npm run check:validators
scripts.test: vitest run && vitest run --config vitest.m3-compat.config.ts && npm run test:pattern-source && npm run test:pattern-model-verify && npm run test:ontology-corpus-prepare && npm run test:ontology-release-verify && npm run test:wrangler-config && npm run test:validators
scripts.//deploy: Ships apps/web/dist as static assets. Prefer `npm run deploy:api` from the repository root, which builds the web app first.
scripts.//db:local: Applies the ordered db/d1 directory, not just 0001. Deleting .wrangler state is an explicit developer reset, not the migration mechanism.

//moment-timezone: DATA ONLY. src/services/tzdb.ts imports data/packed/latest.json and decodes it; the library's own runtime is a UMD file inside a CommonJS package that @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers refuses to load, and pulling in `moment` to answer two questions would put a date-formatting library in a Worker that needs neither. The dependency exists so package-lock.json pins the tz database version M5 day boundaries are resolved against — Intl exposes none.
